title: AI image generation dashboard with content-derived orange accent
attribution_visible_in_image: Visible: 'AG' logo; the supplied filename is 'AI image generation dashboard - Creative AI Web UI'. Creator not confirmed.

observed.layout: Dark app window: left icon rail (5 circular icons); 'Generate Images' prompt panel with a text area, 'AI prompt' toggle, '3D Render Style' selector with thumbnail and + button, Model and Style rows with chevrons, 'Image Detail' slider (Low/Medium/High), and a full-width orange 'Generate' button. Top: 'AG' logo and mode tabs (Image active in orange, Video, AI tools). Center: large portrait with tags (9:16, Classic, Photo) and a caption. Right: a grid of variants including a 'Generation...' loading tile with a star icon and a stacked 'Collections - 42 Presets' card in peach.
observed.hierarchy: Hero image and the orange Generate button are the two focal points.
observed.typography: Geometric sans; small white/grey text on dark. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Outline icons in circles; star motif.
observed.materials: Flat dark rounded panels, one light peach card for contrast.
observed.background: Light grey outside the app window.
observed.note: The prompt text describes robotic animals while the results shown are human portraits (mockup inconsistency).

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark creative-tool UI whose accent color is drawn from the generated imagery so interface and content share a palette.
implementation_notes: Accent could be derived dynamically from the active image.
Controls are ordered as a workflow: prompt, style, detail, generate.

concept_work.essence: A creative tool where the UI recedes and takes its accent from the work.
what_makes_it_work: Orange accent harmonizes with the images.
Loading state is part of the grid.
gaps_to_make_it_work: White text on the orange Generate button measures about 2.8:1.
Very small type for a dense control set.
Prompt and results do not match in the mockup.

pattern.name: Content-derived accent color in a creative tool
use_when: Creative tools where content is the focus
avoid_when: Content colors are unpredictable and the accent must keep contrast
must_preserve: Accent tied to a single role (primary action and active state)
A loading placeholder in the result grid
adaptation_examples: Music tool: accent from album art.
Photo editor: neutral UI with accent from the selected filter.

lessons: A button's text color must be chosen for the accent it sits on, not copied from other UI.
Tie the accent to the content when the content is the product.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: light card tone (~23%, includes the peach Collections card)
measured.color_roles: Dark neutral UI; one orange accent for primary action and active tab, matching the orange tones of the generated images.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Controls map to the generate workflow and results are central.
Palette harmony between UI and content; clear focal points.
Prompt, style and model selectors, loading tile, gallery and collections follow generation-tool conventions.
Loading state and mode tabs are shown; many small controls and no error or empty states.
Consistent components, but prompt text contradicts the images shown.
Content-derived accent and stacked collections card go beyond a stock dark dashboard.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.76:1; secondary text min 2.15:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
